rows.failure: A coupling loss bound omits the initial relation or applies to losses using unpreserved state
rows.discriminating_case: Use identical transition kernels with mismatched initial outputs, or a loss depending on a hidden variable excluded from the relation.
rows.required_remedy: State the initial relation/current outputs, common feasible information-based policy and measurable bounded loss; carry initial mismatch and within-pair loss error.

rows.failure: An old particle weight is counted twice after weighted ancestor selection
rows.discriminating_case: Under the retained two-state example, direct Bayes and the corrected density ratio give (1/2,1/2); double weighting gives (3/4,1/4).
rows.required_remedy: Record the ancestor proposal probability and apply the target/proposal ratio; distinguish SIS from resample-propagate conventions.
rows.relationship: Related mechanisms only; this supplement does not mark any original row complete.

rows.failure: Finite sale choices are used to claim a finite borrowing-action set
rows.discriminating_case: Hold the sale choice fixed while bridge principal varies continuously; principal16 and17 have equal cost/final cash but different minimum cash.
rows.required_remedy: Represent the amount domain explicitly; distinguish a feasible minimum-funding witness from a liquidity optimum.
